visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-border (zinc-800) for all panels and structural grids to create a Technical/Terminal aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use soft drop-shadows only on floating elements like tooltips, modals, or active drag states.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid flat dark colors. No heavy glassmorphism for main panels to maintain high contrast and scientific precision.
visual_enhancers.textures: Optional subtle grain/noise on the main app background to give it an engineering tool feel.

layouts.app_shell: Full screen (h-screen w-screen) flex-col with NO global scrolling. Scroll should happen inside specific panels.
layouts.header: Fixed top bar (h-14), border-b border-border, containing branding, session status, and global actions.
layouts.main_grid: CSS Grid: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-[320px_1fr_400px] taking up flex-1 (calc(100vh - 3.5rem)).
layouts.left_panel: Design Studio & AI Agent. Flex column, overflow-y-auto. border-r border-border. Contains Tabs for 'Manual Design' vs 'AI Agent'. Manual has sliders/selects. AI has chat interface.
layouts.center_panel: Interactive 3D Viewport. Relative positioning. Contains R3F Canvas taking 100% width/height. Floating toolbar at bottom (export STL, view reset, wireframe).
layouts.right_panel: Predicted Properties & Comparison. Flex column, overflow-y-auto. border-l border-border. Metric cards in a bento grid (2x2). Recharts scatter plot. Candidates list.

component_usage.metric_card: Flat background (bg-zinc-900/50), 1px border, p-4, flex flex-col gap-1. Value in Mono font for precision.
component_usage.sliders: Shadcn Slider, custom styled with primary color thumb and track.
component_usage.tabs: Shadcn Tabs, full width. Solid bg for active, transparent for inactive. No pill shapes, use sharp rectangular tabs.
component_usage.charts: Recharts ScatterChart for Stiffness-Damping plot. Custom dark tooltip, dashed grid lines, and clear axis labels.
component_usage.chat_message: Distinct backgrounds: User (bg-zinc-800/50), AI (bg-blue-900/10 border border-blue-900/30 text-blue-50).

motion.transitions: Fast and precise. transition-colors duration-150 ease-out on buttons and inputs. No slow fades.
motion.panels: Subtle slide-in for candidate cards in the library.
motion.3d: Smooth camera damping (OrbitControls enableDamping) in R3F.

accessibility.contrast: All text must pass WCAG AA against its background. Use high contrast for data labels.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hemp-slider', data-testid='generate-btn').

media.icons: Use lucide-react for UI icons. Minimal, 1.5 stroke width.

3d_libraries_and_steps.implementation: 1) Wrap the center panel in a <Canvas>. 2) Add <OrbitControls makeDefault enableDamping />. 3) Add proper lighting (<ambientLight intensity={0.5} />, <directionalLight position={[10, 10, 10]} intensity={1} />). 4) Mock the complex bio-inspired geometries using simplified representations or procedural geometries (e.g., a TorusKnot for Gyroid, InstancedMesh for Honeycomb, ExtrudeGeometry for Lotus-root) as a visual proxy. Add a wireframe mode toggle. Ensure the canvas responds to window resizing.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: recharts, three, @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei, lucide-react, framer-motion, sonner.
Set up a non-scrolling app shell (h-screen, w-screen overflow-hidden) with a grid layout separating left, center, and right panels.
Implement the 'Design Studio' on the left with a Select for pattern (Gyroid, Spider-web, Honeycomb, Lotus-root) and Sliders for target density, cell size, wall thickness, and hemp %.
Implement the 'AI Design Agent' tab on the left featuring a mock chat where the user specifies requirements and the AI responds with parameter recommendations.
Render the 3D viewer in the center using R3F. Create recognizable placeholder shapes for the patterns if true procedural generation is too complex for frontend.
Implement the 'Predicted Properties Panel' on the right showing the 4 metrics (Shear Modulus, Frequency, Damping, Density) in bento-grid cards.

Include a Recharts scatter plot comparing the generated candidate against baselines (Honeycomb: 126.2 MPa, 1120 Hz, damping 0.0069; Lotus-root: mock values) to visualize the stiffness-damping trade-off.
Style the UI rigorously with the 'High-Contrast Technical' archetype. Stick strictly to pure dark themes (zinc-950/zinc-900) with thin borders and monospaced data readouts.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
NEVER use placeholder text for images. Use robust HTML/CSS components instead.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Maintain high density for dashboards: reduce unnecessary padding so more data is visible without scrolling.
Use color semantically: Blue for primary action, neutral for panels, Red/Orange/Green for status indicators.
Provide immediate visual feedback for all interactive elements (hover, focus, active states).
